profile_text.body:
Hesai Group is a Shanghai-headquartered public company, traded under the ticker HSAI, that describes itself as a global leader in 3D perception and a manufacturer of lidar sensors. According to its own site, its lidar products serve ADAS, autonomous vehicles, trucking, robotics, and industrial applications, and the company says it partners with automotive OEMs, autonomous vehicle, and robotics companies worldwide, delivering mass-produced lidars to customers in over 40 countries. It describes lidar as the eyes of intelligent vehicles, providing high-resolution 3D perception that enables features such as AEB (Automated Emergency Braking) and NOA (Navigation on Autopilot), and it says its sensors meet the standards for L4+ autonomous driving used by robotaxis and robobuses.

The company's own framing places it in physical AI and spatial intelligence as well as automotive sensing, with an emphasis on mass production and market-proven hardware. No litigation, no tracked product listings, and no MCP servers are recorded for Hesai Group. Its registration details list a CIK of 0001861737 and identify it as a for-profit public company.
